Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio, tomus trigesimus, ab anno 1431 usque ad annum 1439 (Welter's facsimile of the Venice edition)
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (editor)
Publisher: Paris and Leipzig: H. Welter, a facsimile by Carl Reinecke Nachf., Berlin, of the Venice printing of Antonio Zatta (title leaves)
Publication Date: 1904 (the Welter leaf, OCR line 77)
Rights: Public Domain (pd-us-by-date: published 1904); the archive.org record carries no rights field, so the imprint date is the basis
Language: lat
Source: archive.org item sacrorumconcilio0030joan, full text from the item's own djvu.txt. Fetched directly 2026-11-15 by the Library thread; the byte count of the downloaded file (4,004,171) equals the size archive.org lists for the djvu.txt.
Provenance note: Extracted unaltered: the item's own djvu.txt is reproduced whole after this header; nothing was stripped, normalized or corrected. Rights basis: published 1904, out of US copyright by date. OCR quality: the Latin is fair, with the long s read as f and noise in the margins and running heads. Line numbers cited in this header are lines of the host OCR; add 12 for this file's own line numbers.
Content note: A volume of additions on the Council of Basel: Mansi's own account of the council, then 'Documenta ad concilium Basileense spectantia' from OCR line 5962 ('Inchoatio sacri concilii Basileensis' at 5968), letters and instruments by year. No session headings were found in it. 'Finis Tomi XXX' at 128813.
